instruction: Please implement a accounting website for managing daily interpersonal accounts. The website should have functionalities for account recording, account classification, and statistical analysis. Users should be able to record each interpersonal account, including time, object, amount, reason, and other detailed information, and can customize account classification, such as receiving gifts, giving gifts, etc. The website should also be able to automatically calculate the total amount and proportion of each type of account, and display the data in an intuitive chart. Define the background as medium spring green and components as green.

Please implement a Bitcoin price prediction game website for users to predict Bitcoin prices. The website should have functionalities for registration, login, price prediction, viewing leaderboards, and viewing historical prediction records. Users should be able to register and log in to the website, predict future Bitcoin prices, view the current leaderboard, view their own historical prediction records, and receive corresponding rewards. Set overall background to frost white, then style components with charcoal.

Please implement a sales system mini-program for sales statistics and management. The mini-program should have sales statistics functionality, including sales amount, order quantity, and new agent statistics. Additionally, it should have a sales code generation function, generating sales codes based on selected courses and books, and including a payment process. At the same time, it should have team management functionality, including managing team members and setting permissions for subordinates. Users should be able to log in to the mini-program, view sales statistics, generate sales codes, manage team members, and set related permissions. Specify porcelain as the base color and olive for all components.

Please update the location information and homepage banner on the website. The website should display the new location information and add a message to the homepage banner to inform users that the store has relocated. Users should be able to browse the website, view the new location information, and learn more about the store relocation. Assign sunlight as the background color and apply gold to all elements.

Please implement a home committee circle sharing mini-program for communication and sharing between parents and teachers. Users can create schools and home committees, apply to join them, and post various types of posts. Posts can be set to be visible only to the class or to all users, and can also be assigned to a specific topic. Posts within the class need to be reviewed by administrators before being published to the school. Administrators are divided into school administrators and class administrators, with different permissions, including posting announcements, pinning posts, and approving class membership applications. Set page background to faint gray; color all components with slate gray.

Please implement a wholesale microservice website for managing orders and distribution. The website should have functionalities for automatically fetching paid orders, merging orders, processing store order items, generating distribution lists, managing delivery orders, and managing loading plans. Users should be able to view and manage distribution lists, delivery orders, and loading plans, and perform related operations. Use a cool gray background and apply charcoal to the UI components.

Please implement a web-based bookkeeping software that allows users to log in, create businesses, and manage accounts. The user should be able to log in to the system, create new businesses, including business name and type. The user should also be able to open created businesses and create an account list, including account name, category, and sub-category. The system should have a graphical interface that allows users to easily navigate and manage data. Set cotton as the body background and use maroon for the UI.

Please implement an MSN message sending website for sending messages to MSN and Yahoo. The website should have functionalities for sending messages, receiving messages, and managing contacts. Users should be able to log in, send messages to MSN and Yahoo friends, receive messages from friends, and manage their contact list. Design the site using frost white as the background and charcoal for content blocks.

Please implement a legal automation tool for analyzing and reviewing legal contracts. Users should be able to upload contract files (PDF or text format), and the tool should automatically analyze the contract, extract key clauses and relevant information, and provide a summary report. The tool should have a simple and intuitive interface, be able to handle PDF or text files, and provide basic report generation functionality. Set all pages to have a light pink background and hotpink components.

Please implement a Micro Job platform for employers and talents to conduct transactions. Employers can post job requirements, including price, time, and job content. Talents can browse and accept orders, and can bid on orders. Employers can select suitable talents based on their resumes. The platform should also have an invitation reward mechanism to encourage users to invite new users to join the platform. Style all pages with a linen white background and burlywood components.

Please develop a child-friendly socio-emotional TV app to improve children's emotional regulation and social skills. The app should contain content specifically designed for children aged 2-12, including interactive games and activities to enhance emotional regulation and social skills. Children should be able to watch children's TV shows, participate in interactive games and activities, and learn social-emotional skills through the app. The app should have a user-friendly interface that is easy for children to use. Set the background color to champagne and the component color to firebrick.

Please implement a news sharing application that rewards users for sharing news. The application should have functionalities for sharing news, tracking clicks, and calculating earnings. Users should be able to log in, browse news, share news to WeChat groups, view the clicks and earnings generated by their shares. The application should also have features such as user rankings and earnings details. Initialize the background color with navajo white and component color with tan.

Please implement a legal propaganda website that provides legal knowledge and information. The website should have functionalities for querying laws and regulations, legal consulting, and legal news. Users should be able to log in, browse laws and regulations, legal consulting, and legal news, query related legal information, propose legal consulting, and read legal news. The website should also have a search function, where users can input keywords to search for related legal information. Establish buttermilk as the main background and peru for the controls.

Please implement a basic web application that can be accessed through a browser. The application should have basic functionalities such as user registration, login, browsing, and searching. Users should be able to register an account, log in, browse the application's content, search for information of interest, and perform basic interactive operations. Assign light yellow to body backgrounds and goldenrod to main components.

Please implement a personal resume website that simulates handwriting and displays animations. The website should have the functionality to input resume information and output it in a simulated handwriting style. At the same time, the website should display css3 and jq animation effects, with the animation showing the input and output process. Users can watch the animation and finally see the output of "Thank you!". Use alice blue as the default background and cornflower blue for component styling.

Please implement a form designer website for quickly generating query and entry forms. The website should have functionalities such as drag-and-drop components, dynamic data set generation, and data set association. Users should be able to add components by dragging and dropping, configure form fields, generate data sets, and associate different data sets. At the same time, the website should support multiple component types, such as text input, dropdown selection, date selection, and more. Configure the background color to pale goldenrod, with components using dark khaki.

Please implement a comprehensive service platform for party building and social governance, used for managing and analyzing social governance events. The platform should have functionalities for data convergence, event perception, collaborative processing, data analysis, and decision-making support. Users should be able to log in to the platform, browse social governance events, perform event analysis and processing, and provide decision-making support. The platform should also have a mobile application to facilitate use by grassroots personnel. Set all pages to have a eggshell background and dark slate gray components.

Please implement a dynamic website building platform with customization features. Users should be able to register and log in to the platform, create and manage their own websites, choose from different templates and themes, and customize the layout and content of their websites. The platform should provide multiple easy-to-use ways to customize websites, including drag-and-drop interfaces and code editors. Users should be able to add, delete, and edit website pages, articles, images, and other content. Configure all backgrounds with thistle and all components with medium purple.

Please implement an instant messaging system for real-time communication between users. The system should have functionalities for sending and receiving messages, creating and managing group chats, adding and managing friends, and viewing message history. Users should be able to log in, send text, images, and voice messages, create and join group chats, add and remove friends, and view their message history. Set the background color to pale ash and the component color to slate gray.

Please implement a web-based music player for playing music. The player should have functions such as play, pause, previous song, and next song. Users should be able to browse the music list, select the music to play, adjust the volume, and view the playback progress. The player should also have lyrics display and music search functions. Define background as pale rose; define components with maroon.

Please implement a Phuket villa booking mini-program for searching and booking available rooms. Users can quickly search for available rooms based on their check-in time, and the system automatically synchronizes booked room data from other platforms and supports combined searches for room changes. Users can browse room information, view room details, book rooms, and manage their orders. Define the background as light salmon and components as tomato.
